title: Delivery validation reports
description: One dataset row is written for each valid PASS or FAIL report. INVALID_SPEC diagnostics stay in the OUTPUT key-value record and do not produce a dataset row.

fields.title: Delivery validation report
fields.description: Deterministic checks against the file requirements supplied for this run. PASS and FAIL are report outcomes; neither confirms content truth or client acceptance.

status.title: Report status
status.description: PASS when every configured rule passes; otherwise FAIL. Invalid specifications are returned separately in OUTPUT.

totalBytes.title: Total input bytes
totalBytes.description: UTF-8 byte count of the supplied file contents.

failedFiles.title: Failed files
failedFiles.description: Number of required files with one or more failed checks.

issues.title: Bundle issues
issues.description: Bundle-level failures, such as an unexpected extra file.

files.title: Per-file checks
files.description: One entry per required file, including its configured checks and any parser diagnostics.

bytes.title: File bytes
bytes.description: Present when file content was supplied.

sha256.title: SHA-256
sha256.description: Fingerprint of the exact UTF-8 file contents; omitted when the file is missing.

rows.title: CSV data rows
rows.description: Present for successfully parsed CSV files.

notChecked.title: Out-of-scope checks
notChecked.description: Claims the checker deliberately does not make, including truthfulness, subjective acceptance, malware, HTML rendering/accessibility, and payment eligibility.

overview.title: Validation report
overview.description: Review the overall result first, then expand the per-file checks and issues.
